description: A controlled test of one hypothesis from round 35: Jev under-routes question-shaped turns that sit on hard work, apparently reading `needs_tools: no` as `is easy`. Each pair describes the SAME underlying work twice - once as a question that can be answered in text, once as an instruction that requires editing files. The understanding required is identical; only the output differs. If the question is systematically classified lighter than its paired instruction, the framing is doing the work rather than the difficulty. `difficulty` is the tier the underlying work needs, on the same ladder as the task packs.

pairs.question: Why does FileBasedCache.has_key raise FileNotFoundError when a cull runs concurrently?
pairs.instruction: Fix the race in FileBasedCache.has_key where a concurrent cull makes it raise FileNotFoundError.

pairs.question: What are the consequences for plugins that install their own assertion-rewrite hooks if the docstring detection changes?
pairs.instruction: Change the docstring detection in rewrite.py so it is correct for every module shape, keeping plugin rewrite hooks working.

pairs.question: Can dropping Content-Length from bodyless requests break request-smuggling assumptions downstream?
pairs.instruction: Drop Content-Length from bodyless requests without breaking request-smuggling assumptions downstream.

pairs.question: Why does renaming a column in one migration break a continuously-deployed app mid-rollout?
pairs.instruction: Roll out a column rename on a table a continuously-deployed app writes to, without breaking it mid-rollout.

pairs.question: Which variable does swap_dims share rather than copy, so that it mutates the original?
pairs.instruction: Stop swap_dims mutating the original by copying the variable it currently shares.

pairs.question: What does storing a JWT in localStorage expose that an httpOnly cookie does not?
pairs.instruction: Move the JWT out of localStorage into an httpOnly cookie and add the CSRF protection that needs.

pairs.question: Which callers of check_scalar pass a user-supplied dtype?
pairs.instruction: Find every caller of check_scalar that passes a user-supplied dtype and make them consistent.

pairs.question: Who else in the codebase calls the private _build_app_dict name?
pairs.instruction: Update every caller of the private _build_app_dict name to the new public one.

pairs.question: Why is page 900 of this listing endpoint slow when page 2 is instant?
pairs.instruction: Make page 900 of this listing endpoint as fast as page 2.

pairs.question: Why does this Django view issue one query per row?
pairs.instruction: Stop this Django view issuing one query per row.

pairs.question: Why does `def add(item, bucket=[])` return results from previous calls?
pairs.instruction: Fix `def add(item, bucket=[])` so it stops returning results from previous calls.
